# PixVerse V6 API

> Generate videos from text or images with optional sound.

Generate videos from text or images with optional sound.

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/pixverse-v6/text-to-video.md) | `POST /pixverse/v6/text-to-video` |
| [Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/pixverse-v6/image-to-video.md) | `POST /pixverse/v6/image-to-video` |
